sentences: Plaintiff, Atiyyah A. Darden (“Ms.

sections.name: STATEMENT OF FACTS
sentences: Ms. Darden began working at Axia as a Medical Assistant on or about February 3, During the course of her employment with Axia, Ms. Darden always performed her job in a satisfactory manner, and she was never disciplined by Axia.
On or about July 27, 2020, Ms. Darden was informed of her termination effective July 24, 2020.
In the weeks prior to her termination, Ms. Darden was not feeling well and had been off work for doctor's appointments.
Ms. Darden was told that she was able to use her sick/vacation time for the time off work.
On or about July 23, 2020, Ms. Darden found out that she was most likely pregnant but would need one more test to confirm.
That test was scheduled for the morning of July 24, 2020.
Ms. Darden advised her Manager, Ann Hartner, of her likely pregnancy on July 23, Ms. Darden was terminated the following day without any reason being given.
As such, the timing of the termination indicates that Ms. Darden was fired due to her advising her employer of her pregnancy.
Ms. Darden’s termination was in violation of the PDA and PHRA because she was fired as a result of her manager learning that she was pregnant.
Ms. Darden began working at Axia as a Medical Assistant on or about February 3, 2020.
During the course of her employment with Axia, Ms. Darden always performed her job in a satisfactory manner, and she was never disciplined by Axia.

sections.name: COUNT I
sentences: Discrimination in Violation of the Pregnancy Discrimination Act Plaintiff incorporates by reference all of the allegations contained in all paragraphs above.
Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 prohibits employment discrimination based upon an individual employee’s sex. 42 U.S.C. §2000e-2(a).

The Pregnancy Discrimination Act of 1978, amended Title VII to state that: i. The terms “because of sex” or “on the basis of sex” include but are not limited to, because of or on the basis of pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; and women affected by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions shall be treated the same for all employment-related purposes, including receipt of benefits under fringe benefit programs, as other persons not so affected but similar in the ability or inability to work.
Ms. Darden was within the protective class of individuals as designated by the PDA. Ms. Darden was able to perform the essential functions of her position with Axia.
Ms. Darden was terminated by Axia solely as a result of her pregnancy.

As a direct and proximate result of the conduct of Axia in violating the PDA in discriminating against Ms. Darden on the basis of her pregnancy, Ms. Darden has been permanently and irreparably harmed and damaged and has and will continue to lose benefits of employment such as lost earnings, lost employment benefits, and non-economic damages in the form of embarrassment, humiliation, and anxiety.

WHEREFORE, Ms. Darden demands that the Court declare the conduct engaged in by Axia to be in violation of Ms. Darden’s rights under the PDA and award all compensatory damages, lost wages (and raises) and benefits, front pay and back pay, lost future earning capacity, punitive damages for intentional, willful, malicious, reckless, outrageous conduct, damages for emotional distress, reasonable attorneys fees and costs incurred herein and any pre- and/or post- judgment interest on all money awarded in damages for delay.
Plaintiff incorporates by reference all of the allegations contained in all paragraphs above.

sections.name: COUNT II
sentences: Discrimination in Violation of the Pennsylvania Human Relations Act Plaintiff incorporates by reference all of the allegations contained in all paragraphs above.

This is an action arising under the provisions of the PHRA, and this Court has, and should exercise, pendant jurisdiction over the same because the cause of action complained of in this Count II arises out of the same facts, events and circumstances as Count I, and therefore judicial economy and fairness to the parties dictates that this Court be brought in the same.
